Do you mean one of these?

- Castle of Santa Maria da Feira (Portugal): Often informally called “Feira Castle,” a landmark medieval castle in Santa Maria da Feira, Aveiro District, with 11th–15th century phases and iconic turrets.
- Fort of Feira (Lines of Torres Vedras, Portugal): A Napoleonic-era redoubt in the defensive Lines north of Lisbon, part of Wellington’s fortification system (early 1800s).
- Old Feira / Fort Feira (Luangwa, Zambia): Ruins at the Zambezi–Luangwa confluence; originally a Portuguese feira (trading post) from the 18th century, later a BSAC/colonial-era fortification.
